day1_insight: There's been no rain at all lately, so stormwater runoff isn't a factor right now. The model's main signals right now: high tide level is raising risk — a high tide can mobilize bacteria held in wet sand and push the waterline toward outfalls; high tide timing is raising risk — how long before mid-morning the last high tide fell, which sets how much the water has just washed off the upper beach; and tidal range is raising risk — large tidal swings resuspend bacteria stored in sediment and wet sand. The most recent sample, 5 days ago, was over the limit at 640 MPN/100mL, and bacteria tend to linger from one sample to the next.
